caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic or porcelain figurine of a dog standing on a rectangular green base. The dog has a textured, off-white body with small round shapes suggesting curly fur, particularly around the front and shoulders, and features several green and black spots across its body. The head of the dog is rounded with a white face, black eyes, and a red mouth, featuring a red streak on the snout and a pronounced red tongue. The ears are large, pendulous, and colored black with inner red accents. The legs are short and sturdy, marked by black patches around the ankles. The tail is curled upwards and is also tipped in black. The entire figure is rendered against a plain, beige background, with no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Pa. German Prince Charles Spaniel
